images.title: My looks
images.description: Keep complete looks in one in-game gallery and switch between them with one click
images.alt: The My looks gallery in NCL Skins with several saved player looks

images.title: Edit and preview a complete look
images.description: Check the skin, Classic or Slim model, Cape or Elytra, and Second layer settings before saving
images.alt: The Edit look screen in NCL Skins with a large player preview and appearance controls

images.title: Browse skin collections
images.description: Find Minecraft characters and skins from collections provided by active Java resource packs
images.alt: The NCL Skins Catalog with Search and multiple skin cards

images.title: Import a skin from your preferred source
images.description: Choose a local skin file, find a Player skin by name or UUID, or enter a direct public Skin file URL
images.alt: The NCL Skins Import screen with options for a local file, player name or UUID, and a direct Skin file URL

images.title: Built into Minecraft
images.description: Open My looks by clicking your player on the Main Menu or Game Menu
images.alt: Minecraft Main Menu with the integrated Current player appearance preview from NCL Skins
